title: TroubleshootDiagnostic
description: Emitted by Easby-producer when operator says 'loop doesn't sound right' without naming a target. Runs the 10-Q Owsinski diagnostic (O-Ch14, see 11-owsinski-producer-handbook.md §11) and reports the first failing question + variation direction.

failed_at.description: Q# from the 10-Q diagnostic. Q1=parts known, Q2=same-way-every-time, Q3=dynamic breath, Q4=hold drive at low vol, Q5=starts/stops, Q6=tight unit, Q7=in tune, Q8=groove/pocket, Q9=tempo, Q10=lead range.

next_decision_kind.description: Mapping: Q1/Q2 → Refusal (clarify intent); Q3 → VariationDecision (velocity/accent); Q4 → VariationDecision (transient-shape); Q5/Q6 → VariationDecision (unison-accent); Q7 → Refusal (defer to aubio); Q8 → VariationDecision (preserve pocket); Q9 → Refusal (defer to AnalysisCoordinator); Q10 → VariationDecision (register-shift).
